image_description: A close-up shot of a dark metal toilet paper holder mounted on a beige wall, holding two rolls of toilet paper. The top roll is partially used, revealing a cardboard core, while the bottom roll is fuller. Both rolls feature printed text and graphics that appear distorted and nonsensical, characteristic of AI generation artifacts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits the cylindrical geometry of a toilet paper roll wound around a central axis.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions relative to the holder appear consistent with standard household dimensions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the concept of sheets exists, distinct perforation lines are not visible; instead, the surface is marred by printed artifacts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The expected embossed texture is obscured by heavy, nonsensical text overlays and graphical smearing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The hollow center and the edge of the cardboard tube are visible in the top roll.
The base color is off-white, but it is heavily contaminated by brown/black printed gibberish, violating the 'throughout' purity condition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears smooth and plasticky due to the AI-generated text artifacts, lacking natural fibrous detail.
No clear perforation lines are discernible amidst the visual noise.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The overall form factor correctly identifies the object as a household paper roll.

artifact_observations.location: Surface of both toilet paper rolls
artifact_observations.reasoning: Severe hallucination of text and logos. The characters are malformed, inconsistent, and nonsensical, indicating a failure in rendering realistic packaging or print.
The paper lacks the expected soft, fibrous texture. Instead, it has a smeared, slightly glossy appearance where the text artifacts blend into the paper material.

artifact_observations.location: Top roll inner edge / Cardboard core interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the paper layers and the cardboard core is slightly blurred and irregular, lacking the crisp geometric definition of a real rolled product.
